verdict.rationale: Ramp's own marketing directly claims the story: 'AI-powered intake parses contracts and screenshots to auto-populate request forms.' This sits alongside documented procurement request flows: unified requests, procurement approvals, and parallel approval routing across finance, IT, legal, and security. The evidence is a single homepage line with no dedicated docs or hands-on confirmation. Missing for 10: detailed first-party documentation of contract-parsing intake (which fields are extracted, supported formats, accuracy and review steps), and independent or hands-on corroboration that contract parsing populates procurement forms.
